problem_type: Exact durable receipt actions must survive projection and grouping
symptom: Successful canvas write has no original receipt Undo button in real Electron.
direct_cause: Lane projection omitted undoable correlation; grouped receipt rendering discarded the Undo handler.
class_root: UI action availability was not derived from the existing domain receipt and precise current transcript identity.
affected_population: Every reversible canvas write displayed through lane v4
Repeated tool groups and reopened conversations
entry_points: Cold restart durable committed receipt hydrate
internal_only_reason: Existing internal store, approved UI component and lane admission API own this invariant; no external dependency behavior changes.
invariants: Only the exact current successful call with matching receipt, approval and action hash exposes Undo.
Clicks reread the existing owner and retain main-process CAS; UI data grants no authority.
generality_proof: One pure correlation join covers all domain tools and both single/group rendering; all clicks recheck current state then enter the existing compensation transaction.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive a display reference from exact current durable receipt correlation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both pass the exact tool call ID through the original receipt component.

recurrence.reason: Every successful tool or repeated tool group may omit Undo with the same projection gap.
same_class_scan: Searched undoable/onUndoTool/committedProposal across v4 and lane consumers.

prevention.invariant: Only the exact current successful call with matching receipt, approval and action hash exposes Undo.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, failed, denied or stale correlation exposes no action.
prevention.strategy: Derive display capability from the original owner and rerun the same join at click time.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace stale captured last-proposal callback with exact clicked-call resolution. No parallel Undo implementation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime, schema or external format changes.

migration: No format changes. Existing G5 hydrate restores the record; existing lane custom entries restore correlation.
residual_risks: Real Electron click and compensation acceptance are owned by the independent runner.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The shared display correlation owns exact identity; proposalUndo retains execution authority.
